description: Flood impact assessment in Sao Vicente and Santo Antao Islands, Cabo Verde (13 to 16 August 2025) is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: FL20250812CPV This map illustrates satellite-detected mudflow extent in Sao Vicente and Santo Islands, Cabo Verde as observed from Pleiades very high-resolution satellite image acquired on 13 to 16 August 2025. Within the analyzed area, approximately, about 16 km² of land appears to be affected by flood. Coverage: Cabo Verde. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-03-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
